name: Woad Warrior
description: A woad warrior is a fearsome fighter known for their light-footed prowess and mastery of several types of weapons. These warriors are famous for their distinct face paintings that identify their tribes. Woad warriors are skirmishers that rely on quickly focusing down an enemy while staying out of reach.

actions.name: Wild Spear
actions.description: The woad warrior strikes a target with their spear, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the woad warrior makes this attack again without consuming an action. This attack can be made with an additional 1 range, but at a cost of a 1d4 penalty to the attack roll.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: The woad warrior makes an attack with their shortbow at a creature within 8 units, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Seax Strike
actions.description: The woad warrior makes a quick, sweeping attack with their seax, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the target gains the bleeding condition if they take damage after calculating mitigations.

actions.name: Flank
actions.description: In response to an allied creature making an attack against an enemy creature adjacent to the woad warrior, they makes an attack against that same creature with their Seax action with a 1d4 bonus.

actions.name: Skirmish
actions.description: After using either the Wild Spear or Short-Bow action, the woad warrior moves up to 2 units.

traits.name: Strength in Numbers
traits.description: When the woad warrior has an ally within 3 units, they become immune to the afraid condition and gain a 1d4 bonus to resistance checks.
